meta.title: SoftFacture Afrique — Invoicing for freelancers and small businesses
meta.description: Quotes, invoices and payment tracking. French solution for freelancers and small businesses — hosted in France, GDPR compliant.

marketing.announceMessage: E-invoicing: SoftFacture is preparing Accredited Platform connection before the 2027 SME deadline.
marketing.heroBadge: Currencies and tax rules tailored to your business
marketing.heroSubtitle: The invoicing solution for SMEs and freelancers. Quotes, invoices, payments — configurable VAT and currencies. Data hosted in France.
marketing.heroTag: E-invoicing preparation for France (Accredited Platform connection).
marketing.feat2Desc: EN 16931 structured data and dispatch via your Accredited Platform (OD connector).
marketing.feat4Desc: Professional PDF and structured XML preview.
marketing.testimonial: “Finally a modern UI for our invoices — we save a lot of time.”
marketing.pricingTeaserNote: Enjoy a {days}-day free trial when you sign up. See our plans and pricing on the dedicated page.
marketing.faq1A: Yes. Your data is hosted in France, accessible only to your authorized team, and processed in compliance with GDPR.
marketing.faq2A: Yes. You get one free month on signup with no commitment.
marketing.faq3A: Yes. Create personalized quotes and convert them to invoices in one click.
marketing.faq4A: Yes. Record payments and see paid, partially paid or pending invoices.
marketing.faq5A: Yes. Export documents as PDF and use your data for accounting.
marketing.faq6Q: Is SoftFacture suitable for small businesses?
marketing.faq6A: Yes. Built for freelancers, tradespeople, consultants and small businesses.
marketing.faq7Q: Is SoftFacture ready for mandatory e-invoicing?
marketing.faq7A: At launch, SoftFacture covers classic invoicing (quotes, PDF invoices, VAT, payments). Accredited Platform connection and Factur-X export will be offered before the small-business deadline (September 2027).
marketing.finalCtaDesc: Join entrepreneurs who want to spend less time on admin.
marketing.footerTagline: Online invoicing for freelancers, independents and small businesses.
marketing.footerBrandNote: SoftFacture Afrique is a Nexiora brand.
marketing.problemIntro: Today, many freelancers and small-business owners lose several hours each week to:
marketing.problemOutro: SoftFacture automates these tasks so you can focus on your business.

marketing.f2Desc: Turn your quotes into invoices instantly.
